div.div: A worker that claimed a run fetches the run's specification with the run token its poll answered. The runs domain builds it in one transaction; the workers domain seals its secrets to the key of the pool's current certificate, for that run at that state version, so only the customer's launcher can open them.

text.tspan: A worker that claimed a run fetches the run's specification with the run token its poll answered. The runs domain builds it in one transaction; the workers domain seals its secrets to the key of the
pool's current certificate, for that run at that state version, so only the customer's launcher can open them.
